<!DOCTYPE html><script type="module">
window.addEventListener('message',async event=>{
 if(event.data.event!=='benchmark-start')return;
 try{
 const {root,module,native,batch,concurrency}=event.data;const load=p=>import('file://'+root+'/out/'+p);
 const [{RPCProtocol},{ProxyIdentifier,SerializableObjectWithBuffers},{VSBuffer},{Emitter}]=await Promise.all([load(module),load('vs/workbench/services/extensions/common/proxyIdentifier.js'),load('vs/base/common/buffer.js'),load('vs/base/common/event.js')]);
 const {wrapStructuredCloneMessage}=await load('vs/base/parts/ipc/common/ipc.js');const port=event.ports[0];
 const {RPCMessagePort}=await load('vs/workbench/services/extensions/common/rpcMessagePort.js');const traffic={sent:0,received:0};
 const post=message=>{traffic.sent++;port.postMessage(message);};const protocol=new RPCMessagePort(post);if(!batch)protocol.sendStructuredClone=post;
 port.onmessage=e=>{traffic.received++;protocol.acceptMessage(e.data);};port.start();
 const client=new RPCProtocol(protocol);const id=new ProxyIdentifier('electron-benchmark');const proxy=client.getProxy(id);
 const settings=Object.fromEntries(Array.from({length:100},(_,i)=>['editor.setting'+i,{enabled:true,value:i,scopes:['user','workspace']}]));const results=[];
 for(const [name,value] of [['primitive',42],['undefined-value',undefined],['small-object',{command:'open',options:{pinned:true},ids:[1,2,3]}],['settings-100',settings],['text-4KiB','a'.repeat(4096)]]){
 const check=last=>{if(JSON.stringify(last)!==JSON.stringify(value))throw new Error('mismatch '+name);};
 check(await proxy.$echo(value,undefined,42,undefined));for(let i=0;i<200;i++)await proxy.$echo(value,undefined,42,undefined);for(const k in traffic)traffic[k]=0;const times=[];
 for(let s=0;s<3;s++){const start=performance.now();let last;for(let i=0;i<1024;i+=concurrency){if(concurrency===1)last=await proxy.$echo(value,undefined,42,undefined);else last=(await Promise.all(Array.from({length:concurrency},()=>proxy.$echo(value,undefined,42,undefined))))[0];}times.push((performance.now()-start)*1000/1024);check(last);}
 results.push({name,microsecondsPerRoundTrip:times,...traffic});}
 window.reportBenchmark({module,native,batch,concurrency,hasBuffer:typeof Buffer!=='undefined',results});client.dispose();port.close();
 }catch(error){window.reportBenchmark({error:String(error.stack)});}
});
</script>

<!DOCTYPE html><script type="module">
window.addEventListener('message',async event=>{if(event.data.event!=='benchmark-start')return;try{const{root,module}=event.data;const load=p=>import('file://'+root+'/out/'+p);const[{RPCProtocol},{RPCMessagePort},{ProxyIdentifier}]=await Promise.all([load(module),load('vs/workbench/services/extensions/common/rpcMessagePort.js'),load('vs/workbench/services/extensions/common/proxyIdentifier.js')]);const port=event.ports[0];const traffic={packets:0,logical:0,notifications:0};const record=data=>{traffic.packets++;if(ArrayBuffer.isView(data))traffic.logical++;else for(const m of Array.isArray(data)?data:[data]){traffic.logical++;if(m.header[0]===13)traffic.notifications++;}};const adapter=new RPCMessagePort(data=>{record(data);port.postMessage(data);});port.onmessage=e=>{record(e.data);adapter.acceptMessage(e.data);};port.start();const client=new RPCProtocol(adapter);const id=Object.assign(new ProxyIdentifier('notification-benchmark'),{notificationMethods:['$notify']});const proxy=client.getProxy(id);const results=[];const same=(a,b)=>{if(JSON.stringify(a)!==JSON.stringify(b))throw Error('Value mismatch');};
for(const[name,arg]of[['primitive',42],['small-object',{command:'open',ids:[1,2,3]}]]){for(let i=0;i<200;i++)await proxy.$echo(arg);const times=[];for(let sample=0;sample<3;sample++){const start=performance.now();let value;for(let i=0;i<1000;i++)value=await proxy.$echo(arg);times.push((performance.now()-start)*1000/1000);same(value,arg);}results.push({name:'echo-'+name,microsecondsPerOperation:times});}
for(const burst of[32,512])for(const[name,arg]of[['primitive',42],['settings-100',Object.fromEntries(Array.from({length:100},(_,i)=>['setting'+i,{value:i,enabled:true}]))],['text-4KiB','a'.repeat(4096)]]){await proxy.$reset();for(let i=0;i<64;i++)proxy.$notify(arg,undefined,42,undefined);same((await proxy.$state()).count,64);const times=[],samples=[];for(let sample=0;sample<3;sample++){await proxy.$reset();traffic.packets=traffic.logical=traffic.notifications=0;const start=performance.now();for(let i=0;i<burst;i++)proxy.$notify(arg,undefined,42,undefined);const state=await proxy.$state();times.push((performance.now()-start)*1000/burst);same(state.count,burst);same(state.last,arg);samples.push({...traffic});}results.push({name:'notify-'+burst+'-'+name,burst,microsecondsPerOperation:times,traffic:samples});}
window.reportBenchmark({module,hasBuffer:typeof Buffer!=='undefined',results});client.dispose();adapter.dispose();port.close();}catch(error){window.reportBenchmark({error:String(error.stack)});}});
</script>
